messages:
devin: Quick preflight — pushing the delta installer bundle for Private VPC customers in the next change window. Need checksum + signer confirmation before we open cutover. Expected window: Tue 2024-11-05 03:00-04:00 UTC. Please ack.

anya: Ack. Uploading artifact to staging S3 now. Will post sha256 and cosign sig when done. ETA ~2m :package:

ops-bot: build/canary pipeline passed for commit `release/private-vpc/2024-11-delta` (job #4521). all tests green. artifacts: s3://redwood-private/deltas/2024-11-05/bundle.tar.gz

anya: sha256: `b3f2c4a9d8e1f2c3b4a5e6f7c8d9e0f1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e7f1` (full in handoff doc). cosign sig uploaded: `cosign.sig` -> s3://redwood-private/signatures/2024-11-05/ :lock:

mike: @anya are we rotating the image-signer key for this release? Need KMS thumbprint for customer handoff.

anya: We are using current signer key `projects/redwood/kms/keys/release-signer-v2`. Thumbprint: `KMS-TP-7f9a`. No rotation this window to reduce risk. Note in release notes.

sophia: I'll include that in the release notes and call out the non-rotation. Also adding the note about airgap manifest changes. @releases-bot can you create the release entry?

releases-bot: release created: `private-vpc-delta-2024-11-05` (draft). Added notes placeholder. Cutover window set to 2024-11-05 03:00-04:00 UTC. Canary group: 10% of onprem customers (staged label).

devin: Canary plan: 1) push bundle to canary mirrors, 2) run smoke-installer on 5 canary nodes, 3) monitor errors/latency 15m, 4) escalate or rollback. Pin manifests for canary with `manifest-pin: sha256:b3f2c4a9d8e1f...`. Will not change manifest during canary.

anya: Upload command I ran:
```
aws s3 cp bundle.tar.gz s3://redwood-private/deltas/2024-11-05/
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/... bundle.tar.gz
```

ops-bot: airgap-mirror upload complete. mirror://canary/2024-11-05/bundle.tar.gz available. Verification: OK. Checksums match: sha256=b3f2c4a9d8e1f2c3b4a5e6f7c8d9e0f1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e7f1

mike: For rollback, what's the binary pin we fall back to? Need exact manifest ref.

anya: Rollback target: `manifest:v2024-10-21-stable` (sha256: a9d4b2c7e1f9c3b8d7a6e5c4b3a2f1e0c9d8b7a6). Rollback steps in case of failures:
```
# rollback quick
kubectl apply -f manifests/manifest-v2024-10-21-stable.yaml -n redwood
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/redwood-installer -n redwood
# monitor logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=installer -f
```
Also notify support and freeze further rollouts until postmortem.

devin: Good. Decision: proceed with canary at start of window. If any SLO regression >5% errors or installer failures >2 nodes, abort and roll back to `v2024-10-21-stable`.

sophia: I've updated release notes with SHA and KMS thumbprint, and added rollback instructions. Share final signoff once canary green.

anya: Signed and uploaded cosign.sig, s3 ACL set to private, handoff doc updated: docs/airgap/handoff-2024-11-05.md. Also added a troubleshooting checklist for common airgap failures.

releases-bot: scheduled: private-vpc-delta-2024-11-05 -> change window confirmed. Reminders will go to #customer-success and #support 30m prior.

mike: ACK, watching during window. If anything odd ping me DM.

devin: :thumbsup: thanks team. I'll post final canary status after 20m monitoring.
